output.title: Partner approval for large billing write-downs
output.summary: Replace the nightly job with ERPx standard billing adjustments, plus one extension that holds write-downs above the threshold until the engagement partner approves them.
standard_coverage: Recording write-ups and write-downs on billing lines
output.trigger: When a write-down is submitted on a billing line
behaviour: Calculate the write-down as a share of the billable value, after any client rate
At or below the threshold, let the adjustment proceed
Above the threshold, hold it and ask the engagement partner for approval
On approval, release the adjustment and record the approver and date
On rejection, return it to the project manager with the reason
data: Threshold: one configurable value, not a value in code
Approval record: billing line, partner, decision, date. Retained seven years, per policy 4.3

api_calls.purpose: Read the billing line and its project
api_calls.call: Read billing line through a supported API
Submit the adjustment through a supported API, never a table write
Start an approval task for the engagement partner

dependencies: INT-09 feeds the client rate table this rule reads, so it must load rates into ERPx before go-live
open_points: The customer must choose the threshold: 10% in code, 15% in policy
Unit4's technical lead must confirm which extension option to use
output.caveat: ERPx extension options and API names are to be confirmed with Unit4.
